transcription.text: Once, even as a mission leader,
this young missionary began to cry
and asked to be sent home.
he couldn't find the right word to explain.
if he had the testimony of the Book of Mormon,
I bought my testimony of the Book of Mormon
I then encouraged him to begin to study the scriptures, especially the book of Mormon.
He and his trainer made a scripture study plan letter.
I received a letter from this missionary testifying of how the early scripture study had helped him understand his purpose as a missionary.
He said, and I quote, I am happy now and do not want to be sent home any longer.
My friends, I invite you to start the scriptural diligence
